text:
Nora Blake: Heads-up: multiple EU trials reporting activation emails delayed and search returning partial results. I pulled an affected list (~73). Need quick comms + credit offer. :warning:

Diego Martin: Infra update: index-writer consumers fell behind after a short burst of downstream 5xxs combined with two JVM pauses. We applied a retry-cap and scaled consumers at 1798765400. Drain ETA ~35-50m.

Ivy Chen: Draft customer note below. Want empathetic tone and a clear next-step (booking link).

Ivy Chen: "Hi — we're sorry for the interruption. Some customers in EU may see slower activation and partial search results while we clear an indexing backlog. Our engineers applied mitigations and we're monitoring the queue. We expect recovery within 1-2 hours.

What's happening: temporary index write backlog caused by transient downstream errors and worker pauses.

What we did: capped retries, increased processing capacity, and will perform case-by-case backfills for high-touch accounts.

What you get: impacted trials will receive a $175 account credit automatically. To request prioritized support, book a slot: https://cal.redwood.ai/cs-officehours

We'll send an RCA after the incident. — Redwood Support"

Nora Blake: Good. Standardize credit to $175 for trials under 120 days. Manual backfill only for enterprise/high-touch. I'll flag any accounts >$10k ARR for AE outreach.

Diego Martin: Deploy event: https://deploys.redwood.ai/roll/retry-cap-311 — success @ 1798765605. Queue drain: 40% in 15m, 78% in 32m.

InfraBot: Incident INC-4922 logged — status: mitigated — affected=73 — office hours link attached.

Ivy Chen: Sending first wave to affected customers now (in-app + email). Subject: "Service update: temporary activation delays for some EU trials". Includes booking link and credit note.

Diego Martin: Full drain at 1798768120. No data loss detected. We'll include GC tuning and a consumer-lag alert in the postmortem.

Nora Blake: Timeline: 1) customer note sent (Ivy) 2) status page update when drain=100% 3) RCA + tailored renewal comms within 24h 4) credits issued + feedback survey within 48h.

CS Bot: Noted — incident INC-4922 moved to mitigated. Affected_count=73.

Nora Blake: Thanks team. I'll coordinate with AEs and post follow-up RCA draft here tomorrow. If any high-touch responses come in, please @ me. :pray:
